name: Dead or Alive Dimensions
description:
DEAD OR ALIVE Dimensions (DOAD) is
a fighting game that can be enjoyed by
anyone, no matter their level of
ability! Enjoy thrilling combat against
computer opponents, take on a friend 
in a duel and have virtual battles 
with other players using StreetPass.
disclaimer: Please use Parental Controls to restrict 3D access for children 6 and under.
